command:
set -euo pipefail
T=$(mktemp -d /var/tmp/go-webgl-cap.XXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
cat > "$T/gate.html" <<'HTML'
<!doctype html><meta charset=utf-8><body><canvas id=c width=64 height=64></canvas><script>
window.onerror=(m,s,l,c,e)=>{document.body.textContent='JSERROR '+m+' @'+l+':'+c+' '+((e&&e.stack)||'')};
try{const c=document.getElementById('c');const gl=c.getContext('webgl')||c.getContext('experimental-webgl');if(!gl){document.body.textContent='RESULT_JSON '+JSON.stringify({webgl:false});}else{const dbg=gl.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');document.body.textContent='RESULT_JSON '+JSON.stringify({webgl:true,version:gl.getParameter(gl.VERSION),sl:gl.getParameter(gl.SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION),vendor:dbg?gl.getParameter(dbg.UNMASKED_VENDOR_WEBGL):gl.getParameter(gl.VENDOR),renderer:dbg?gl.getParameter(dbg.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL):gl.getParameter(gl.RENDERER),max_texture:gl.getParameter(gl.MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE),error:gl.getError()});}}catch(e){document.body.textContent='JSERROR '+e.stack;}
</script>
HTML
for mode in default angle swiftshader; do
  echo ===$mode===
  case "$mode" in
    default) F='' ;;
    angle) F='--use-gl=angle' ;;
    swiftshader) F='--use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader' ;;
  esac
  /usr/bin/google-chrome --headless=new --no-sandbox --allow-file-access-from-files $F --virtual-time-budget=5000 --dump-dom "file://$T/gate.html" 2>"$T/$mode.err" | tail -8
  echo STDERR; tail -12 "$T/$mode.err" || true
done
echo LIVE_SUBJECT; sha256sum buehne.html buehne_daemon.py filmlook.js; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service
echo SCOPE=READ_ONLY_WEBGL_CAPABILITY
